title: Uncover and remediate uninstrumented failure paths in Console insight pipelines
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Summary: During two capacity-related incidents on 2026-02-18 and 2026-02-22, the Console's insight pipeline silently degraded for a subset of tenants. The incidents manifested as slow or missing per-tenant tail-latency heatmaps and stale token-cost breakdowns. On-call could not quickly diagnose the root cause due to missing metrics and absent traces across the request fan-out path.

Observed gaps:
- No end-to-end per-tenant request correlation ID propagated from API gateway into the insight ETL workers.
- Key intermediate metrics missing: per-tenant KV cache hit ratio, ETL worker queue depth, and commit-latency for the summarization job.
- Dashboards aggregated across clusters, masking hot-tenant effects; no percentile breakdowns beyond p95.
- Traces stopped at the gateway for many timed-out requests; downstream RPCs were not instrumented with span annotations for backpressure and queue-wait.

Impact: Several customer-facing dashboards showed stale or reduced fidelity results for ~2 hours during peak. Customers reported slower console load and delayed cost rollups. The platform automated fallback to lower-fidelity reports but visibility to the failure modes was delayed, increasing MTTR.

Root cause hypothesis: A combination of increased tail latency in the ETL summarizer (triggered by a quantization rollout on runtime nodes) and a recent deployment that removed a tagging step that previously propagated correlation IDs. That removed correlation combined with aggregated dashboards meant the SRE on-call had no direct signal to link latency spikes to particular tenants.

Work to do: This ticket centralizes concrete instrumentation and dashboard changes plus immediate mitigations to reduce MTTR and prevent recurrence.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Add missing metrics and traces such that an on-call engineer can pinpoint the failing tenant and pipeline stage within 10 minutes for similar incidents. 2) New dashboards surface per-tenant p50/p95/p99 latency, KV cache hit ratio, ETL queue depth, and summarizer commit latency across regions. 3) Runbook updated with playbook steps leveraging new signals. 4) Automated alerts created for per-tenant tail-latency and queue-depth anomalies with clear paging thresholds.
dashboards_to_update: Console > Insights > Per-Tenant Latency (add p50/p95/p99 and tenant filter)
Console > Insights > KV Cache Heatmap (per-tenant, per-region)
Console > Insights > ETL Pipeline Overview (queue depth, commit latency, worker count)
SRE > Incidents > Tenant Hotspots (auto-linked to tenant/trace)
Cost > Token Cost Rollups (surface staleness and failed rollups)
tracing_points: API gateway: attach and forward X-Correlation-ID for all insight requests
Ingest service: start span with tenant_id tag before write to Kafka
ETL worker: add span annotations for queue_wait_ms, processing_start_ms, processing_end_ms
Summarizer: add commit span and record commit_latency_ms and rows_processed
Reporting service: annotate fallback path and staleness detection reasons
runbook_updates: Add section: Using per-tenant dashboards to confirm hot-tenant vs cluster-wide issues
Add step: If per-tenant ETL queue_depth > threshold, scale summarizer pool and open rollback runbook for recent model/quantization rollouts
Add step: If correlation ID missing, run diag script to verify deployment tagging in the last 24h
Include links to new dashboards and example queries for quick triage
comments: 2026-02-25 Sofia Martinez: Created ticket after postmortem review. Tagged eng-observability and SRE for prioritization.

2026-03-01 Mei Chen (SRE): Confirmed alert thresholds and proposed paging policy for per-tenant p99 > 2s. Will validate thresholds on staging.
2026-03-04 Design Review (Aisha Rahman): Dashboard layout suggestions accepted; recommend tenant filter default to top-10 by volume.
